evidence: task/tests/scoring.toml lines 1-11: [gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0; [weights] functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2; [floors] functional = 0.05. scoring.toml, tools/score.py and test.sh are byte-identical (diff empty) to the frozen rules/projects/webdev-task-template copies, so no template-controlled policy was altered. Gates carry no reward mass: score.py line 46 computes weighted only over [weights]; gate dims are used only as the gates_passed predicate (line 41, score > 0.0). Both gate judge.toml use aggregation = all_pass with a single binary criterion. Gates apply before shaping: test.sh writes the zero record first with an EXIT trap (lines 59-60), runs the gates suite (budget 1500) then score.py; exit 1 (gate failed) -> exit 0 keeping the zero-reward detailed record, other non-zero -> write_zero_reward; only exit 0 proceeds to run_suite scored 11100. score.py line 42 also forces scored dims to 0 when gates fail even if a stale scored/reward.json exists. Executed the frozen score.py (python -B, log dirs in scratchpad) on synthetic RewardKit outputs: render=0 with perfect scored -> reward 0.0, exit 1; constraints=0 -> 0.0, exit 1; gates only (no scored) -> 0.0, exit 0; functional 0.0357 (one 1.5/42 criterion) with polish=visual=1 -> reward 0.0 (weighted 0.4214 withheld by floor); functional exactly 0.05 -> 0.0 (strict >); functional 0.0714 -> 0.4428; all 1 -> 1.0; missing gate/scored key -> exit 2 (test.sh then writes plain zero). Functional weights total 42.0 (16 binary criteria), smallest 1.5 = 0.036 < floor, so polish/visual cannot be farmed by an app that passes the gates and at most one small functional item. Each scored prompt also restates a global browser gate zeroing blank/static shells. Note (not a defect, template-controlled): the 0.05 floor is shallow - a gate-passing app that only passes signin_and_client_scope (3/42 = 0.071) with perfect polish/visual would score 0.4428; but that criterion requires real server-side auth and cross-matter refusal, polish/visual criteria depend on working send/delete/transcript/retention features, and the floor value is mandated by staged-task-contract.md, so it is not changeable here.
